info.title: Chillax - Sales HTTP API
info.description: The Sales Microservice HTTP API for POS tickets, payments and receipts

get.summary: Open tickets for the branch (the POS floor)

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Settled bills for the branch, newest receipt first
get.description: The receipts screen: the way back to a bill after it closed, to reprint it or refund it. Pass receiptNumber to find one.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Closed tickets — settled or voided — newest first, with the count (the back office)
get.description: The window is on the moment the ticket closed: settledAt for Settled, voidedAt for Voided. Pass receiptNumber to find one bill regardless of the window. Read-only; the till's own list is /settled.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Payments taken on tickets settled in a window, newest first
get.description: Windowed on the ticket's settle, not the payment, so the page adds up to the range report's tender split for the same window. Pass tender to see one kind.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Credit notes issued in a window, newest first
get.description: Every refund across the branch's tickets; open the ticket for the lines behind one.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Tab payment slips taken in a window, newest first
get.description: Money customers handed the till against their tabs. Not sales: the bills were counted when they went on account.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Take money against a customer's tab
post.description: Cash into the drawer, card or InstaPay to the terminal — never Account. A numbered slip, stamped with the branch's open shift so the drawer count and the Z report include it; Accounts lowers the balance owed off the event. Slips are never voided: a mistake is reversed by a manual charge on the ledger (and a cash pay-out if cash was handed back).

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: One tab payment slip, to reprint it

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Ticket detail with lines, payments and receipt number

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

delete.description: Opened by mistake and never used. Counter and table tickets with no lines only — nothing happened on them, so there is nothing to audit and the row is deleted. A ticket with lines is voided (owner) instead.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Settled sales over a window: tender split, discounts, per-type counts
get.description: The caller picks the window — pass the branch's business-day bounds for the day report.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Settled sales in a window by hour, weekday, cashier and item
get.description: offsetMinutes is how far the caller's clock is ahead of UTC; hours and weekdays come back in it.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: The ticket a confirmed order landed on
get.description: 404 while the order's confirmation event is still in flight — the POS polls this after creating a counter sale.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Open a counter or table ticket by hand
post.description: Room tickets are never opened this way — they follow their session events.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Add a manual line to an open ticket

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.description: Payments must cover the total; on cash, the excess is returned as change. Issues the receipt number.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.description: No target: the table-turnover split, a fresh ticket for the same place. A target ticket: onto that open bill — the customer who ordered at a table and then took a room. A new ticket: a fresh counter tab, or a table's bill (opened if the table has none) — the customer who moved tables or went to pay at the counter. Session time never moves; a table or counter ticket left empty is discarded. Returns the ticket the lines ended up on.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Name the customer on chosen lines
post.description: The split-bill fix: several people rang up as one sale, and some lines were theirs. Sets the customer snapshot on just those lines — bill grouping, receipt, Account tender. Points do not move: they follow the whole order (assign the order's customer in Ordering for that). Session time cannot be reassigned.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Take a percent or an amount off the whole bill, with a reason
post.description: Exactly one of rate (a fraction, 0.1 is 10%) or amount; the reason is optional. A cashier is capped by the branch's MaxCashierDiscountRate; an owner is not. Given again, it replaces the earlier discount.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

delete.summary: Take the discount back off an open ticket

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Void an open ticket with nothing owed (owner only)
post.description: A mistake, a comp, a walked group. The reason is the audit trail. Settled tickets cannot be voided.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Refund lines of a settled ticket as a numbered credit note (owner only)
post.description: Full or partial, by line and quantity. Each line gives back what the customer paid for it, service charge and VAT included. Cash comes out of the drawer; Account credits the named tab. Loyalty points the refunded orders earned are clawed back in proportion. The settled ticket itself never changes.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: How a branch's menu prices become the bill: VAT, whether it sits inside the price, service charge

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

put.summary: Set a branch's VAT and service charge (owner only)
put.description: Rates are fractions: 0.14 is 14%. Service applies to what is ordered at tables and rooms, never to counter sales or room time. Applies to tickets settled from now on; printed receipts keep their figures.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: A settled bill's receipt, for a customer who was on it
get.description: The customer's own copy of the printed receipt. Allowed for whoever sat in the room, ordered a line, or paid a share; 404 until the bill is settled.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Open the branch's drawer shift with a counted float

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: The branch's open shift as a live X report (404 when none)

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: One shift as an X (open) or Z (closed) report

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

get.summary: Closed shifts, newest first — the Z-report history

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Record cash paid into or out of the drawer

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.

post.summary: Count the drawer and close the shift
post.description: Freezes expected cash and over/short; returns the Z report.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: The API version, in the format 'major.minor'.
